title: Gradient banner
summary: Colour a banner with a left-to-right gradient and white text.
brief: The banner’s background runs from left to right, from #ea580c (orange) to #db2777 (pink).
All the text in the banner is white (#ffffff).
hints: A gradient is an image, not a colour, so background-color will not take it.
background-image: linear-gradient(…) with a direction and two colours. Left to right is 90deg (or to right).
color is inherited: set it once on .banner and the heading and paragraph follow.
solutionNotes: Gradients are generated images, so they belong in background-image (or the background shorthand). The angle sets the direction: 90deg points to the right, so the first colour is on the left. Text colour is inherited, so one color on the banner covers both lines.
